description.zh:
* 是否需要自动旋转功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. By default, this feature is disabled.
* true: Enable automatic rotation.
* false: Disable automatic rotation.

description.zh:
* 本字段和BODY字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* You must specify either this field or the BODY field, but not both, and neither can be empty.
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* You must specify either this field or the URL field, but not both, and neither can be empty.
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image data in the HTTP body.
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云题目识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于扫描、拍照场景的单题题目识别，适用于智能批改等场景的题目内容识别。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多文本格式|支持印刷体文本以及公式的OCR识别。| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |返回坐标|可实现对题目中的配图位置进行检测并返回坐标位置。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [教育场景识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=question_ocr#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[题目识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0111%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduQuestionOcr?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Question Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud, designed for recognizing individual questions in scanned or photographed images. It is suitable for scenarios such as intelligent grading where question content recognition is required. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technology and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over many years and offers key advantages including service stability, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Multiple Text Formats | Supports OCR recognition of printed text and formulas. | | Image Enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Broad Coverage of Image Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images affected by blur, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds. | | Coordinate Output | Detects the position of illustrations within questions and returns their coordinates. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Education Scene Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) service. Before and after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=question_ocr#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Question Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0111%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduQuestionOcr?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the recognition result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on how to grant permissions, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both width and height must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (width-to-height or height-to-width) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend using images with both dimensions exceeding 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down the API response. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images.
|
